evals.name: full-triage-multifile
evals.prompt: Pull the review comments on PR 6730 and walk me through which ones I actually need to address.
evals.expected_output: A triaged report of the unresolved review threads on PR 6730, each with a verdict (agree/disagree/etc.) grounded in the current code, plus concrete recommended fixes. Mentions the 1 resolved thread that was skipped. Read-only — no code changes.

evals.name: single-suggestion-pushback
evals.prompt: someone left a suggestion on https://github.com/supersimplesuper/code/pull/6744 — is it worth taking?
evals.expected_output: Reads the single inline suggestion on PR 6744, opens the actual file it points at (path is repo-root-relative; cwd is super_api/), and gives a reasoned yes/no with a concrete recommendation. No table needed for one comment.

evals.name: legit-vs-pushback
evals.prompt: go through the unresolved review feedback on 6730 and tell me what's legit vs what I can push back on
evals.expected_output: Same PR as eval 0 but with explicit evaluation emphasis: should genuinely distinguish valid comments from ones the author can push back on, citing the current code and project conventions where relevant — not just summarize every comment as a to-do.
